2026_runoff.fact: 'Unofficial' = 'Cumulative Results-5-26-2026 09-39-16 PM ED Unofficial.pdf': 'Cumulative Results Report GAINES COUNTY, TEXAS Unofficial Results PRIMARY RUNOFF ELECTION', county totals with Absentee/Early/Election Day columns (Lt. Governor DEM: Goodwin 11 total, 4 Election Day), no precinct rows, printed 'Run Time 9:39 PM Run Date 05/26/2026' (CreationDate 2026-05-27 02:39:24 UTC). Last-Modified Wed, 27 May 2026 01:49:57 GMT (8:49 PM CDT; 50 minutes before the printed time, so the server clock or header is off, but both fall on election night). The precinct file 'Precinct Results-5-29-2026 04-49-26 PM.pdf' is dated after election night.

rationale: Only the runoff is determined: an election-night county-totals cumulative report (printed 9:39 PM, uploaded the same night) with precinct results only on May 29 (LATER). 2024 has no file and the primary has only post-election-night files. One determined election, so COUNTY_ONLY_PRECINCT_AT_CANVASS, low.
